title: NDP 2026: T-Minus 3 Weeks
description: Three weeks to ship a brand-new parade app feature for 40,000 people. No pressure.
storyContext: 2am. Phone buzzes. The NDP committee wants a brand-new app feature for 40,000 spectators — in three weeks. Your team lead: "We ship this or we don't ship at all."

software-engineer.title: Plan the Build
software-engineer.instruction: Fans point phones at floats, fun facts pop up. Put the build steps in order.
software-engineer.hint: Agree on a plan first. Test the riskiest part early.

items.label: Write a shared plan so teams don't clash
Quick test: can the camera actually recognise floats?
Build the system that sends float info to phones
Test the feature inside the real NDP app
Simulate 40,000 people using it at once

software-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Clean plan. Your lead pins it in the team chat: "THIS is how we ship." 🚀
software-engineer.consequenceFail: Two teams build the same thing twice. Annoying — but now you know why plans come first.

data-scientist.title: Forecast App Downloads
data-scientist.instruction: Marketing needs next week's download estimate. Four weeks of data on the graph — where does it land next?
data-scientist.hint: Each weekly jump is bigger than the last. How much bigger?
data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: Nailed it. Marketing preps exactly enough capacity and buys you bubble tea. 🧋
data-scientist.consequenceFail: Downloads blow past your estimate. Marketing panics, then forgives you. Growth curves are sneaky.

cloud-engineer.title: Pick a Hosting Plan
cloud-engineer.instruction: 40,000 users on NDP day, near-zero the other 364. Pick your hosting.
cloud-engineer.hint: One loud day, 364 quiet ones. What matters most?

options.label: [[Serverless]] — costs nothing when idle, scales up on the day. First users each hour wait 2 extra seconds.
options.consequence: Serverless it is — the finance team sends a heart emoji. Just don't be the first user each hour. 💸

options.label: Book fixed machines plus extras for NDP day. Rock solid, but you pay while they sit idle.
options.consequence: The machines hum along — fully paid, mostly napping. Finance raises an eyebrow. Reliability isn't free.

options.label: Spread the app across Singapore for instant loading. Great for content; the float scanner may lag.
options.consequence: Pages load lightning-fast island-wide. The float scanner? It's... thinking. The crowd taps impatiently.

options.label: Partner with a local provider already running government services. Reliable and local, less flexible.
options.consequence: The partner's team slots right in. Fewer knobs for you to turn, but someone experienced has your back.
